Japanese troops used bamboo poles to stick magnetic mines onto tanks—the Type 99 disc with TNT, magnets, and a delay fuse. Kill the suspension, strand the Sherman. US counters went sand paint, wood planking, then heavy concrete. Want the full countermeasure breakdown next?
